title: Kusanagi Nene — Trying On Cuteness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... I'm done running for the day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Okay, what was my time...? Good. I'm getting closer to my goal.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I haven't had time lately because I was practicing for that show at the carnival, but I can start training like normal again now that it's done.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, speaking of that carnival... Momoi and Akiyama sent some messages about it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They said people are talking about our show on social media... I guess I'll take a look.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... Where'd I put my phone...?
Oh, if it isn't Nene!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Tsukasa...?
Are you also here for a run?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I actually just finished.
Are you taking a break?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I was gonna look at what people have been saying about our show. Akiyama and Momoi mentioned that it's been getting a lot of buzz.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
I still haven't had a chance to look much, so mind if I join you...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sure.
Umm... Here, take a look at these comments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What did they say...?
“That show was really heartwarming, and those cats were so cute!”
“Thank you for that wonderful show! It's become a great memory for us!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's always nice to receive this sort of feedback from the audience...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And lots more people have posted their thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa, these ones are about you...
It looks like Nyantaro has a ton of fans now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Of course he does! He is that carnival's hero, after all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, you also seem to have no small number of fans! Quite a few people were impressed by the way you and Airi Momoi worked in perfect sync during the show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Sounds like our effort was worth it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It really is nice to see these sorts of comments...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Especially since it shows we were able to create another fun memory for all the guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and the carnival will live on as long as those memories stay alive...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier that I was able to help with its legacy!
<Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Morning, Nene... Wait, huh?!
I didn't know Tsukasa was here with you☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<This is perfect♪
I'm hoping you two can help me with something!>
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Welcome, Nene, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Over here, you two♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're all together. Is something going on...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, they wanted to ask you guys about the show you did at that carnival!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the one we did during Meow Park's final day?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku seems to have fallen completely in love with it. She's been telling us all about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
The Ferris wheel stopping probably came as a huge shock, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We heard that you had to ad-lib quite a lot...
How did you manage it?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
Tsukasa suggested that we work the technical difficulties into our show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, Miku already knows everything...
Why do you need to ask us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
The picture Miku gave us wasn't entirely crystal clear...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We do know that it was a very fun performance...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That's understandable...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But! But!
It was super duper fun! And my head gets so jumbled whenever I try to talk about everything that happened!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, it was really, really fun and exciting and explosively entertaining!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. This is basically how she's been describing it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that is nice to hear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, because it means our show left a big impression on Miku.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The carnival's gone, but the memory we created still lives on...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I felt the same thing while reading everyone's comments earlier. Seeing it in person like this drives the feeling home all the more...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nene! Tsukasa!
You gotta tell us more about what happened!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna hear more too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We certainly have plenty to share.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Well, for starters...
In the original story...
